#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Recover only a verified immutable gzip prefix; never complete an absent tail."""
import base64, hashlib, json, os, re, stat, time, zlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/tmp/hia-native12-prefix-recovery-20261114-dda7')
MANIFEST_GIT='f8fbd2b7cfc4217f9afbfd752ceff7d3af663437'
EXPECTED_PARTS=30
EXPECTED_PREFIX=3932160
MAX_DECOMPRESSED=256*1024*1024
def pin(b):
    return {'bytes':len(b),'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
def plain(p):
    s=p.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_nlink==1,(str(p),s)
    b=p.read_bytes()
    after=p.lstat()
    fields=('st_dev','st_ino','st_mode','st_nlink','st_size','st_mtime_ns','st_ctime_ns')
    assert tuple(getattr(after,k) for k in fields)==tuple(getattr(s,k) for k in fields),(str(p),'changed while reading')
    return b
def exact(b,p):
    got=pin(b)
    assert all(got[k]==p[k] for k in ('bytes','git_blob','sha256')),(got,p)
    return got
def output(name,b):
    p=ROOT/name
    with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(b)
    return pin(b)
def encoded(x): return (json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n').encode()
def octal(b):
    s=b.strip(b'\0 ')
    assert not s or re.fullmatch(b'[0-7]+',s),b
    return int(s or b'0',8)
started=time.monotonic()
report={'schema':'hepta.native12.prefix-member-recovery.scan.v1','product_calls':0,'binder_calls':0,'old_paths_recreated':False,'original_inode_identity_reused':False,'source':'actual Git fullGET parts000-029','closed_cas_claimed':0}
try:
    mb=plain(ROOT/'MANIFEST.json')
    assert pin(mb)['git_blob']==MANIFEST_GIT
    manifest=json.loads(mb)
    report['manifest_pin']=pin(mb)
    prefix_expected=json.loads(plain(ROOT/'PREFIX-EXPECTED.json'))
    rows=[]
    prefix=ROOT/'PREFIX.tar.gz.partial'
    with prefix.open('xb') as out:
        for i in range(EXPECTED_PARTS):
            row=manifest['parts'][i]
            p=ROOT/row['file']
            raw=plain(p)
            exact(raw,row['pin'])
            item=json.loads(raw)
            assert item['ordinal']==i and item['count']==207 and item['offset']==i*131072
            data=base64.b64decode(item['data'],validate=True)
            exact(data,item['decoded_pin'])
            assert len(data)==131072
            out.write(data)
            rows.append({'ordinal':i,'transport':row,'decoded_pin':item['decoded_pin']})
    pb=plain(prefix)
    assert len(pb)==EXPECTED_PREFIX
    report['prefix_pin']=exact(pb,prefix_expected)
    report['verified_transport_parts']=rows
    report['missing_suffix']={'first_missing_part':30,'last_missing_part':206,'parts':177,'bytes':manifest['archive_pin']['bytes']-len(pb),'full_archive_pin':manifest['archive_pin']}
    dec=zlib.decompressobj(31)
    tarpath=ROOT/'DECOMPRESSED.tar.partial'
    total=0
    with tarpath.open('xb') as out:
        for start in range(0,len(pb),65536):
            pending=pb[start:start+65536]
            while pending:
                block=dec.decompress(pending,4*1024*1024)
                total+=len(block)
                assert total<=MAX_DECOMPRESSED,('recovery output cap',total)
                out.write(block)
                pending=dec.unconsumed_tail
    report['gzip_eof']=dec.eof
    report['gzip_unused_data_bytes']=len(dec.unused_data)
    report['gzip_final_crc_verified']=bool(dec.eof)
    report['decompressed_prefix_bytes']=total
    assert not dec.eof,'unexpected complete gzip stream; stop rather than relabel the scope'
    closed=[]
    offset=0
    with tarpath.open('rb') as f:
        while offset<total:
            f.seek(offset)
            h=f.read(512)
            if len(h)<512:
                report['truncated_member']={'stage':'header','offset':offset,'available':len(h)}
                break
            if h==b'\0'*512:
                report['tar_zero_block_offset']=offset
                break
            checksum=octal(h[148:156])
            assert checksum==sum(h[:148])+8*32+sum(h[156:]),('header checksum',offset)
            name=h[:100].split(b'\0',1)[0]
            pre=h[345:500].split(b'\0',1)[0]
            if pre: name=pre+b'/'+name
            name=name.decode('ascii')
            assert name=='INDEX.json' or re.fullmatch(r'cas/[0-9a-f]{64}',name),(name,offset)
            assert h[156:157] in (b'0',b'\0'),(name,'not regular')
            assert octal(h[100:108])==0o600,(name,'unexpected tar mode')
            size=octal(h[124:136])
            padded=(size+511)//512*512
            available=total-offset-512
            if available<padded:
                report['truncated_member']={'stage':'body_or_padding','name':name,'header_offset':offset,'expected_body_bytes':size,'available_body_bytes':min(size,max(0,available)),'expected_padded_bytes':padded,'available_after_header':max(0,available)}
                break
            row={'name':name,'header_offset':offset,'body_offset':offset+512,'bytes':size,'next_header_offset':offset+512+padded}
            if name=='INDEX.json':
                assert offset==0 and not closed
                b=f.read(size)
                exact(b,manifest['index_pin'])
                output('INDEX.json',b)
                report['complete_index_pin']=pin(b)
            else:
                assert report.get('complete_index_pin'),'CAS is not admitted without the complete internal index'
            closed.append(row)
            offset+=512+padded
    report['closed_tar_members']=closed
    report['closed_tar_member_count']=len(closed)
    report['status']='PREFIX_SCAN_COMPLETE_NO_FULL_ARCHIVE_CLAIM'
except BaseException as exc:
    report['status']='RECOVERY_SCAN_ERROR'
    report['error']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'text':str(exc)}
    raise
finally:
    report['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
    output('PREFIX-SCAN-R2.json',encoded(report))
    print(json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ('status','prefix_pin','decompressed_prefix_bytes','gzip_eof','closed_tar_member_count','complete_index_pin','truncated_member','error') if k in report},sort_keys=True))
